planets.name: TOI-1803 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1803 with a 12.9-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-1803 c was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-1803. Its orbit and size follow Zingales et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
